I answered Dana in a thread on their #north-team message: the hub replacement for Zoom Room B is **IT ticket #4092**.

Ilse posted that number in #north-random on Oct 13 at 11:55, along with a warning not to unplug the power brick under the table because that resets the Polycom. I included the warning in the reply. Dana is in #north-random, and so is everyone in #north-team, so repeating it there was fine.

I didn't find any later update on the ticket, so I suggested Dana check with IT or #help-it-ops if they need to know whether the hub has been replaced.
